inputs.label: Gran Turismo 3 A-Spec disc image (.iso)
inputs.help: An .iso image of your own Gran Turismo 3 A-Spec disc. The NTSC-U releases (SCUS-97102 and PBPX-95503) are verified.

steps.text: Open GT3 Revisited from Library > Unknown Sources. Choose Open disc image and pick your .iso.

notes: gt3r-android.apk in the same release is the phone build.
